h: Kelechi Iheanacho reportedly sets a Turkish league record in Bursaspor win, sends message to Eric Chelle
p: Kelechi Iheanacho is said to have broken a record in the Turkish league during Bursaspor's latest win. He also reportedly sent a message to Super Eagles coach Eric Chelle, in an apparent bid for a national team recall.
more: The striker has been out of the Super Eagles picture recently.
Reaction online has been split between praise and calls for a recall.
